description: Inspect one publicly reachable website or API and return a machine-readable capability report: the entry points it exposes (endpoints, forms, feeds, MCP tools), the evidence behind every finding, and an explicit list of what could not be determined. Only public responses are read; a 401/403 is recorded as auth_required and never bypassed. Use it to plan an integration, document an undocumented API, or triage a vendor before you build on it. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base, no account, no API key). 【価格】0.01 USDC。【使い方】呼ぶと 402 と PAYMENT-REQUIRED（支払い条件）が返る。USDC で支払い、同じ引数に PAYMENT-SIGNATURE ヘッダを添えて再送すると結果が返る。
